brand.title: Lanka Rail Reserve
brand.heroHeadline: Your seat, for exactly as far as you travel.
brand.heroSub: Reserve hill-country railway journeys by segment. When you step off at your stop, the same seat carries someone onward.

waitlist.title: Join the waitlist
waitlist.body: We will notify the next eligible passenger when a cancellation makes a seat available for this entire journey segment. Joining does not reserve a seat or charge you.
waitlist.contactHint: Enter at least one contact method. Availability notifications are sent in first-joined order to passengers whose complete segment can be accommodated.
waitlist.joinError: The waitlist request could not be completed.
waitlist.contactError: Enter an email address or phone number.
waitlist.joinedBody: Keep this reference safe. A notification means a seat is available, not reserved; complete a new booking promptly before another passenger takes it.
waitlist.cancelError: The waitlist entry could not be cancelled.

passenger.title: Passenger and fare
passenger.contactHint: Provide an email or phone number. You will use it with your reference to securely manage this booking.
passenger.quoteError: The fare or seat hold could not be created.
passenger.renewHold: Check and hold this seat again

confirmation.title: Your journey is reserved.
confirmation.cancelConfirmBody: Your ticket will be cancelled, the seat will return to availability, and the eligible payment amount will be refunded.

lookup.title: Lookup Booking Reference
lookup.sub: Enter your unique booking reference to view ticket status or manage your reservation.
lookup.notFound: No active booking found with that reference code.

schedules.title: Hill Country Railway Stations & Distance Map
schedules.sub: Colombo Fort to Badulla Main Line station order, cumulative distances, and codes.

help.title: Frequently Asked Questions
help.a1: Segment booking allows passengers to reserve a specific seat only for the portion of the route they travel. When a passenger gets off at Kandy, that exact seat immediately opens up for another traveller heading to Ella.
help.q2: How long is my fare quote held?
help.a2: Fare quotes are locked for 5 minutes once calculated to guarantee your seat price while completing passenger details.
help.a3: Yes, active bookings can be cancelled at any time using your booking reference code.
